TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2315-17 West Barry Avenue
From RS-3 to RT-4

The Property
The subject property is improved with a three and a half story, multi-unit residential building containing three

dwelling units. The surrounding area is comprised of Mi-2, C1-2, B2-2, RT-4, and RS-3 zoning districts. The
area is improved with buildings of various heights ranging from 1 to 4 stories that contain residential and
commercial uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance as it is within 420 feet of the Western Avenue and 690 feet of the Belmont Avenue Bus Line
Corridor Roadway Segments.

The Project
The Applicant proposes a substantial renovation of the existing building, and to expand the floor area to allow for

a rear addition to the building. There are four automobile and three bicycle parking spaces proposed. The zoning
height of the building will remain at 37 feet 7 inches. To allow the proposed development, and to correct existing
non-conformities, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for the subject property from the RS-3 District to a RT-4
District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application for the proposed project, and seeks all relief
necessary and as allowed under the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, as set forth in section 17-13-0300(D), including,
but not limited to: 1) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the west side setback to 0 feet to
accommodate existing conditions, the east side setback to be 8 feet 4 4 inches, and the combined side yard setback
to be 8 feet 4 4 inches, and 2) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front yard setback to 0 feet to
accommodate the existing stairs.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 4,740.80 square feet

Floor Area: 5,688.96 square feet

FAR: 1.20

Residential Dwelling Units: 3

MLA Density: 1,580.30 square feet

Height: 37 feet, 7 inches

Automobile Parking: 4

Bicycle Parking: 3

Setbacks: Front (Barry Ave.) 0 feet*
Side (West) 0 feet*
Side (East) 8 feet, 4 1/4 inches
Rear (Alley) 44 feet, 9 3/8 inches

Applicant to seek all relief as needed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.
